item.g:title: 2016 Hyundai Elantra Value Edition
item.g:description: The Value Edition was the sweet spot of the 2016 Elantra lineup, and this one reads 96,503 miles, well under most of what is listed locally in the same year and trim. It runs the 1.8 liter four cylinder with the six speed Shiftronic automatic, driving the front wheels. Value Edition is where Hyundai loaded in the equipment that normally costs extra: a power glass sunroof, heated front seats, a backup camera, keyless entry with keyless start, alloy wheels, and fog lights. On top of that you get air conditioning, cruise control, power windows and power door locks, Bluetooth, SiriusXM satellite radio alongside the AM/FM and CD system, an alarm system, and a tilt and telescoping steering wheel. Safety coverage includes hill start assist control, electronic stability control, traction control, four wheel ABS, and dual, side, and full length head curtain air bags. Finished in red over a black interior.
